description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Industrial Disputes between, Chandrani Wijekoon Vs. SLTB; M. J. M. Rizvi Vs. Seylan Bank PLC; D. N. Wanniarachchi and P. L.K. G. Gunawardana Vs. Sri Lanka Transport Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and amendments, making it clearly a legal/regulatory notification rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
